address.name: Address
address.head: Where is the home?
address.lede: Street and postcode. We look up the rest as you type — the postcode, the neighbourhood and the pin — and you correct anything that looks wrong.
address.why: The address decides the neighbourhood guests filter by, and it is the one thing that sends an approved listing back to review whenever you change it.

nearby.name: What's nearby
nearby.head: What is around it?
nearby.lede: Pick the places that matter to someone living here for six months. We measure the distances ourselves, from your pin.
nearby.why: A company housing someone for six months asks about the tram and the supermarket before it asks about the terrace.

basics.name: The home
basics.head: What kind of home is it?
basics.lede: The numbers guests filter by. Nothing here is a guess we make for you.
basics.why: Bedrooms, bathrooms and floor area are the three filters almost every company uses when searching for staff housing.

photos.name: Photos
photos.head: Show us the home
photos.lede: One gallery, in the order a guest swipes through it. Take the widest shot you can from each doorway.
photos.why: The first photo that is not a floor plan becomes your cover — on the search card and at the top of your listing. The order you set here is the ranking.

description.name: Description
description.head: Tell guests about it
description.lede: Write it in Spanish, then in English. We do not translate for you yet, so both are yours — and you approve the English before it goes live.
description.why: Companies read this to judge whether their person will be comfortable there for six months. Both languages, because half our tenants read English first.

amenities.name: Amenities
amenities.head: What does it come with?
amenities.lede: Pick everything the home actually has. Fifteen things, and every one of them is a filter.
amenities.why: Each chip is a filter on the search page. An amenity you leave off is a search you never appear in.

pricing.name: Price & availability
pricing.head: What does it cost?
pricing.lede: Your price is for thirty days — not for a calendar month, so the daily rate never swings with February. Then bills, the deposit, the turnaround and the shortest stay you accept.
pricing.why: A thirty-day price plus real availability is what turns a view into a request. Our commission comes off once per stay, from the first month — never again for that tenant.

rules.name: Rules & terms
rules.head: Your rules and terms
rules.lede: Be specific. We answer every tenant question for you, so a clear no is worth more than a vague maybe.
rules.why: We handle every tenant conversation — but only from what you tell us here. A missing rule is the usual cause of a cancelled stay.

paperwork.name: Paperwork
paperwork.head: Last part: the paperwork
paperwork.lede: Five things, once. We check them before your listing goes live, and guests never see them.
paperwork.why: Verification is why companies book here at all. The green badge is the whole reason your listing is trusted.

paperwork.terms: I own this property or I am authorised to let it, and I accept the host agreement — Ebrostay's 15% commission on rent, capped at thirty days' rent and charged once per stay; rent pro-rated daily and collected per calendar month; stays of 31 days up to just under a year; and free tenant cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in.

signedOut.title: Sign in to manage your homes
signedOut.body: Your listings, requests and availability live behind your account.

pitch.title: List your home.
pitch.lead: Anyone with an account can list on Ebrostay. You bring the home; we bring the bridge to the companies that need it — mid-term tenants, checked before they reach you.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.copy: Create an account or sign in with the one you have. It takes a minute and costs nothing.

steps.title: Describe the home
steps.copy: Photos, monthly price, and the months it is free. Our import can read an existing listing and fill most of it for you.

steps.title: We review it
steps.copy: Our team checks every listing before it goes live — the address, the photos, and that both languages read well.

steps.title: Take requests
steps.copy: Manage availability and booking requests from your dashboard. You confirm the final price on each one.

import.title: Is this home already listed somewhere?
import.statusEmpty: Paste a link from one of the six sites above.
import.statusKnown: {source} recognised. We read the whole page, not the search card.
import.statusUnknown: We do not read {host}. Use one of the six above, or the document route below.
import.docBody: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to ten pages: an agency dossier, a listing sheet, or photos of a printed one.
import.blankProse: Nothing listed anywhere? That is fine — the form takes about twelve minutes.
import.neverPhotos: A portal re-compresses and downscales everything it publishes, and many stamp a watermark on it. Your cover photo runs full-bleed on a search card, so a re-encoded crop with a logo in the corner cannot do that job. Yours to upload at full size, in your order.
import.neverAvailability: No portal publishes real dates, and a month wrongly closed costs a booking you never hear about. Closed by hand, by you.
import.neverPaperwork: The five documents are checked against you, not against an advert. Nobody else's PDF can stand in for your NIE.
import.honest: This can take up to a minute. We read the whole listing rather than its summary — we would rather be slow than put the wrong number in your price.
import.errorUnsupportedHost: We do not read that site. Use one of the six above.
import.errorBadUrl: That does not look like a link. Description it from your browser's address bar.
import.errorBodyRequired: We did not receive the link. Paste it again and press Read this listing.
import.errorTooManyImports: You already have two reads running. Wait for one to finish.
import.errorDailyImportLimit: That is as many reads as we run in a day. Try again tomorrow, or fill the form in yourself.
import.errorLoginWall: That listing asks us to sign in, so we cannot read it.
import.errorNotFound: That listing is not there any more.
import.errorUnreadable: We could not make sense of that page.
import.errorTimeout: This is taking longer than it should. Start with a blank form and we will not keep you waiting.
import.errorPipelineError: Something went wrong on our side while reading it.
import.errorResultInvalid: What came back from that listing was not something we could use. Fill the form in yourself, or try another link.
import.errorCancelConflict: The read did not stop — it finished first. Carry on filling the form; what it found will still arrive.

pricing.rentNoBand: Not enough comparable homes listed yet to place this price.

billsHint.included: Part of the monthly price, with no ceiling. You carry whatever the meters say.
billsHint.capped: Part of the monthly price up to the cap — anything over it we invoice to the tenant.
billsHint.excluded: We invoice the tenant for the utilities.

pricing.depositHint: Held by Ebrostay and returned after check-out.
pricing.minStayNote: The longest is up to 12 months — the platform maximum.

breakdown.note: Estimate at 30 days. Our commission is 15% of the rent, capped at 30 days' rent, and charged once at the start of a stay — later payouts are rent in full. Utilities are metered and settled after move-out. We agree the final price with the tenant; you never negotiate.

pricing.saveNote: Price changes apply to new requests only — confirmed stays keep the price they were agreed at. Saving keeps your home in search.

cleaningHint.platform: We inspect, read the meters and deep-clean between stays, and charge the tenant for it. Nothing to organise, nothing in your payout.
cleaningHint.host: You organise the clean and the inspection; we charge the tenant your fee at move-in and pass it to you in full.

pricing.turnoverHint: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} shut after every stay for the inspection, the meter readings and the deep clean. Guests cannot book into them.
pricing.turnoverHintNone: Back-to-back stays. Only choose this if a home can be inspected, read and deep-cleaned the same day.

availability.label: AVAILABILITY · NEXT 12 MONTHS
availability.bandIntro: The band summarises the next twelve months. Pick exact dates on the calendar below — a stay rarely starts on the 1st.
availability.monthsOpen: {count, plural, =0 {FULL} one {# MONTH OPEN} other {# MONTHS OPEN}}
availability.ownUseNote: Dates you close yourself get no turnaround days, and we don't arrange the clean after them. If a stay starts right when they end, the home has to be ready.
availability.selectPrompt: Pick the first and last day you want closed.
availability.noBlocks: Nothing is closed. The home is open for the whole year.
availability.blocksNote: Closing dates hides them from search and from the booking form. Confirmed stays are recorded here too — removing one frees the dates, it does not cancel the stay.
availability.saveNote: Calendar changes go straight through and keep your home in search. Only edits to the listing itself go back to review.
availability.conflict: That span crosses dates that are already closed. Pick a range that clears them.
availability.browseHint: Two months at a time — the band above marks where you are.

billing.label: BILLING & PAYOUTS
billing.figure: {count, plural, one {# PAYOUT AHEAD} other {# PAYOUTS AHEAD}}
billing.moneyPath: The tenant pays Ebrostay on the 1st. We take our commission and pay you on the 5th — you never invoice or chase anyone.
billing.empty: Nothing scheduled. Payouts appear here as soon as a stay is confirmed.
billing.totalLabel: {count, plural, one {# payout ahead} other {# payouts ahead}}
billing.invoicesValue: Monthly, in Spanish, with IVA breakdown
billing.footnote: Payouts leave on the 5th for the month in progress, once the tenant's payment has cleared — if a payment is late your payout moves with it, and we tell you the same day. Our commission is 15% of the rent, capped at 30 days' rent, charged once at the start of a stay. These are scheduled amounts, not settled payments: payout records and your account arrive with the payments system.

billing.title: Billed by the day
billing.body: Rent is pro-rated daily, so you pay for the days you stay — no rounding up to a whole month. The headline price is 30 days.

included.title: Bills included
included.body: Water, power, gas and internet are included in the rent. Nothing to settle at the end.

capped.title: Bills included up to {cap} €
capped.body: Water, power, gas and internet are included up to {cap} € a month. Anything above that is metered and settled in your final bill.

excluded.title: Bills not included
excluded.body: Water, power, gas and internet are contracted and paid by you, separately from the rent.

deposit.title: Deposit {amount} €
deposit.body: Due when you move in, and returned after move-out once the final bill is settled, less any documented damage.

cancellation.title: Free cancellation
cancellation.body: Cancel at no cost up to 48 hours before check-in.

cleaning.title: Cleaning included
cleaning.body: Cleaning between stays is arranged and paid by us.

reachInfo.label: How are these times measured?
reachInfo.title: Measured from the street
reachInfo.origin: Every time and distance starts from the home's street, not from its door. We publish the street, never the house number.
reachInfo.range: So each time is a range: the quicker end of the street and the slower end. When both ends give the same answer, you see one number.
reachInfo.rounding: Distances are rounded to the nearest 50 m.

schedule.note: Rent is charged per calendar month, so the first and last instalments are part-months. You can pay further months up front if you prefer — we agree the intervals before you move in.

estimate.title: Price your stay
estimate.hint: Pick move-in and move-out in the calendar. Days with a diagonal line are taken.

estimate.tooShort: The minimum stay is 31 days. Extend the dates.

typeCompare.title: Display typeface comparison
typeCompare.intro: The same headline, wordmark and card in four typefaces. Familjen Grotesk is the current face (chosen 2026-07-22 in this comparison); Bricolage was v1's display face. Body stays Onest throughout.

note.bricolage: The previous face (also v1's display): warm grotesque with quirky cuts.
note.familjen: The current face: warm grotesque with a calm, rounded skeleton — v1's tone, its own form.
note.schibsted: Sharper and more editorial — the 'serious paper' voice; hardens the whole.
note.fraunces: The wildcard: a warm display serif — a different genre entirely; more classic hospitality, less platform.

design.title: Design system
design.intro: The Ebrostay v2 style book: “the calm ledger of a stay”. River = open, green = yours, ink = occupied.
design.calendarHint: Booked days are crossed with a diagonal line; the month band is only the summary — day-level truth lives here.
design.dialogBody: The booking request is sent by email. The team reviews and confirms it manually.
design.displaySample: One flat, one contract, calm months by the Ebro
design.bodySample: Every home comes furnished, verified and move-in ready. All amounts shown are estimates; the contract sets the final price.
design.datePickersHint: A popover field (move in / move out) that opens the themed calendar — the candidate to replace the native date-input pair. Compare it with the native one below.
design.dpSplitHint: Two calendars in one popover: left = move in, right = move out. Doesn't close on pick, only on outside click.
design.budgetHint: Today's number field says nothing about the market: you can't tell whether €1,200 is generous or hopeless. Three ways to show the distribution, on sample data (26 homes).
design.budgetAWhy: A histogram by price step, median marked. Shows the shape of the market; past your ceiling it's closed water — the same diagonal hatch as a booked day. With few homes the columns give way to one mark per home.
design.budgetBWhy: Cumulative: how many homes a ceiling opens. The flat stretches are the finding — money spent there buys nothing.
design.budgetCWhy: No dragging: three ceilings drawn from the prices themselves (p30 / p55 / p80), each with its count. Holds up on a phone and on a thin catalogue.
design.budgetCompareHint: The same prices drawn both ways, at the same ceiling. Bucketing doesn't break on a small catalogue — it still draws. It just stops saying anything: bar height can only be 1 or 2, the bucket width implies an approximate price when we know the exact one, and the number of buckets is decided by the gap between cheapest and dearest, not by how many homes there are.

auth.deactivated: Your account is deactivated. Contact us to reactivate it.

account.title: My account
account.purgeHelp: This disconnects your sign-in provider from Ebrostay. It does not delete your Ebrostay account — use the closure request above for that.
account.closureHelp: Your published homes stay visible but close to new requests, and you will not be able to create or edit anything. We will contact you before anything is removed.
account.closingHelp: Creating and editing are disabled. Your published homes are closed to new requests. You can undo this at any time.
account.error: Something went wrong. Part of the change may not have gone through: some of your homes may have moved and some may not. Press the button again to finish it — repeating it is safe.
account.unreadable: One of your homes could not be processed and is still published, so it has not been closed to new requests. Nothing you do on this page will change that — please write to us and we will sort it out:

signIn.metaDescription: Sign in to Ebrostay to save homes, follow your bookings and manage your listings.
signIn.title: Sign in to Ebrostay
signIn.lead: Save homes, follow your bookings, and manage the ones you list.
signIn.newAccount: No account? One is created the first time you sign in.

hero.title: Your stay in Zaragoza, ready to move in.
hero.subtitle: Furnished, verified homes for 1–12 month stays, built for relocating professionals and teams.

why.title: As easy as booking a hotel, but for stays of months.
why.intro: Pick dates, compare verified homes and request your stay with clear pricing, human support and conditions ready for companies and professionals.

book.title: Book in minutes
book.body: Soon you'll pick dates, pay online and get your confirmation and invoice instantly. For now you send a request and we confirm right away.

transparent.title: Total transparency
transparent.body: The price you see is the price you pay: rent, deposit and conditions clear from the first click.

automated.title: Automated end to end
automated.body: Contract, payment, deposit, check-in and support handled by software. Less friction, fewer errors.

support.title: Human support, modern channels
support.body: WhatsApp, email and your personal dashboard, in Spanish and English. Fast answers, for real.

datePicker.tooShort: A stay has to be at least 31 days.
datePicker.tooLong: Stay must be under a year (fewer than 365 days).

gate.title: This account is not an admin
gate.body: The admin role is granted to one specific account. If you have access, it is probably on the other door: an Ebrostay account and a Microsoft account are two separate identities. Sign out and sign back in with the one that got the invitation.
gate.deactivatedTitle: The admin console is unavailable while your account is deactivated
gate.closingTitle: The admin console is unavailable while your account is closing
gate.closingBody: A closing account loses every admin permission, including read access — the console cannot show what the API refuses to send. Cancel the closure request and the console comes back immediately.
gate.closingLink: Go to your account to cancel the closure

photos.title: Where the photos were taken
photos.note: A signal, not a check. A photo's coordinates can be rewritten in seconds, so this catches honest mistakes rather than determined fraud. The published images no longer carry this data — these are what the files said before it went.
photos.none: None of the {total} photos carries coordinates. That is normal: WhatsApp and most social platforms strip them, and many cameras never write them.

catastro.note: Asked live and stored nowhere. The register goes stale and the owner may simply be right, so no line here is a reason to reject on its own.

band.title: Street band
band.note: Derived from OpenStreetMap, not typed by the owner. Nobody has read it before you. The guest map shows this line and never the door, so it has to be the right street and long enough that the home could be any on it.
band.mapLabel: The derived street band for this home
band.tooShort: This band is only {n} m long — short enough to point at one doorway. Fine over a block of flats, not over a single house. Check the map before you confirm.
band.confirm: I have looked at the map: this is the right street, and the band is long enough that it does not identify the individual home.
band.never: No band yet. The home will publish with no map until one is derived.
band.failed: Derivation did not return a band. OpenStreetMap's public query service is often busy — try again.
band.derivingNote: Three queries to OpenStreetMap. This usually takes 20 to 30 seconds.
band.retryFailed: That attempt failed. The query service is shared and often busy — waiting a minute usually helps.

decision.rejectLead: The owner reads this note in their dashboard. It is the only thing telling them what to change, so be specific.
